section_1.title: The Big Picture: How AI Dreams
section_1.content: An overview of the Text-to-Image pipeline: How we map linguistic concepts (CLIP) to visual pixels (Diffusion).
section_1.example: Inputting 'A robotic cat playing a violin' and seeing it transform from noise to a sharp, vivid image.

section_2.title: Prerequisites: High-Dimensional Spaces
section_2.content: Visualizing images as points in a massive vector space. Briefly introduce the concept of 'Embedding'—translating a cat's features into numerical coordinates.
section_2.example: Imagine a 3D coordinate system where 'furriness' is the X-axis and 'whiskers' is the Y-axis; a cat sits at (0.8, 0.9).

section_3.title: CLIP: The Bridge Between Text and Vision
section_3.content: Explain Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) as a cross-modal translator that aligns text and image vectors using cosine similarity.
section_3.example: If the text 'fluffy dog' and a photo of a puppy point in the same direction in vector space, the AI knows they match.

section_4.title: Diffusion Models: The Mathematical Sculptor
section_4.content: The forward process (adding Gaussian noise until the image is pure static) and the reverse process (the Neural Network learning to predict and remove noise).
section_4.example: Visualizing a marble statue covered in snow (noise) and the AI 'chiseling' away the noise step-by-step to reveal the statue beneath.

section_5.title: Guiding the Process: The Mathematics of Condition
section_5.content: Explain how the text embedding (from CLIP) acts as a 'magnet' during the reverse diffusion process, steering the noisy pixels toward the desired outcome.
section_5.example: Using the 'robotic cat' embedding to pull pixels into the shape of metal ears and strings during the denoising steps.

import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):

        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"

        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)

        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Map to right side of screen
                x = 2.0 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Big Picture: How AI Dreams", [
            "AI creates images from text descriptions.",
            "This process bridges language and pixels.",
            "CLIP connects text to image meanings.",
            "Diffusion turns noise into sharp images.",
            "These models learn by iterative refinement."
        ])
        
        # Animations
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFD700")
        central_node = Dot(color="#FFD700", radius=0.3)
        label = Text("Neural Network", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(central_node, 'C3')
        label.next_to(central_node, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.play(FadeIn(central_node), Write(label))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00BFFF")
        self.play(central_node.animate.scale(1.5).set_opacity(0.5), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(central_node.animate.scale(1/1.5).set_opacity(1.0), run_time=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF6347")
        features = VGroup(*[Dot(color="#00BFFF") for _ in range(4)])
        self.place_at_grid(features[0], 'B2')
        self.place_at_grid(features[1], 'B4')
        self.place_at_grid(features[2], 'D2')
        self.place_at_grid(features[3], 'D4')
        self.play(FadeIn(features))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#32CD32")
        connections = VGroup(*[Line(central_node.get_center(), f.get_center(), color=WHITE, stroke_width=2) for f in features])
        self.play(Create(connections))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FF00FF")
        final_layer = Circle(color="#FF00FF", radius=0.4).move_to(self.grid['C3'])
        self.play(Flash(final_layer, color="#FF00FF"))
        self.wait(2)
